description: Custom HTML Table Visual for Power BI is a powerful and flexible visual that enables you to display your data in a highly customizable tabular format. Whether you're looking to style your data presentation with HTML and CSS, include images, or offer advanced sorting and interactivity, this visual provides the control and features needed for a polished user experience. 🔧 Key Features: HTML Markup Support: Customize the content of each cell using standard HTML and CSS, giving you full control over text formatting and structure. Image Rendering: Display images directly inside the table when image URLs are provided, including optional fallback images. Custom CSS Styling: Apply your own CSS rules to style rows, cells, or entire tables with precise control. Pagination: Support for pagination with fully customizable page sizes, supporting up to 300,000 rows. Empty State Handling: Define custom messages or HTML for when there is no data available. Custom Sorting: Users can define custom sorting for columns by columns or measures. Identity Columns for Drilldown: Seamlessly enable drillthrough navigation by passing identity columns — even if they are not displayed in the table. This visual is open-source, free to use - always!
